name: Conventions: SKILLS LAB nav entry, repo-scoped page, empty state with Run Scan, scan refused for an uncloned repo
description: From the app root (the seeded acme/payments-api repo), opens Conventions from the SKILLS LAB sidebar section and confirms the repo-scoped page, its breadcrumb and the empty state with the first-scan button Run Scan (Re-scan only appears once candidates exist). Clicking Run Scan on the seeded repo, which has no clone, is refused with a 422 before any file read or model call — so the flow stays read-only and key-free. See e2e/docs/specs/conventions.md.
